messages.content: What is the current Gini Coefficient of USA?

function.name: finance_fetchGDP
function.description: Fetch the GDP of the given country in the given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The name of the country to get the GDP of.

year.description: The year to get the GDP of.

message.content:
The most recent estimates put the United States’ Gini coefficient at roughly **0.42** (on a scale where 0 means perfect equality and 1 means complete inequality). For example:

| Source | Year | Gini |
|--------|------|------|
| OECD (latest available) | 2021 | 0.421 |
| World Bank (latest available) | 2018 | 0.485 |

These figures show that the U.S. has a moderate level of income inequality compared to many other developed countries. The value has been slowly rising over the past decade, reflecting growing disparities in earnings and wealth distribution.
